steps: Visit the official website of the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services of Madhya Pradesh.
Locate and click on the Nationwide Artificial Insemination Programme link.
Read the instructions and click Apply Now.
Fill out and submit the application form with required information.
Wait for confirmation mail and receive the AI Kit upon approval.
parsed.department: Department of Animal Husbandry, Dairying and Fisheries, the Government of India
